structured.feedback: The description is about 215 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out the bristle-shedding and flared-hair complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the "bristles rinse clean" wording (the listing names alcohol or acetone), and the claim of control over every line, which the reviews undercut.
